**⚠️ READ BEFORE SUBMITTING:**
*Issues without the cTrader Automate Log or exact parameter settings will be closed automatically.*

**Which component is causing the issue?**
- [ ] Range Breakout (cBot)
- [ ] Wave Rider (cBot)
- [ ] DynamicSnRBoxes (Indicator)

**Environment Details:**
* cTrader Version: [e.g. 5.0.32]
* Broker: [e.g. IC Markets, FTMO, The5ers]
* Symbol & Timeframe: [e.g. XAUUSD, m5]
* Account Type: [Demo / Live / Prop Evaluation]

**Describe the Bug:**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. (e.g., "The bot skipped a valid breakout at 08:30" or "The drawdown penalty in the optimizer is throwing a zero division error.")

**Parameter Settings (CRITICAL):**
Please list the exact parameters you were using when the error occurred:
* Max Risk % / Max Dollar Risk: 
* Holiday Blackout Enabled?: 
* Take Profit / Stop Loss Methods: 

**cTrader Automate Log / Error Message:**
Copy and paste the exact error text from the "Log" tab at the bottom of cTrader Automate.
```text
(Paste error log here)
```

**Screenshots:**
If applicable, add screenshots of the chart showing the missed trade, the indicator acting weird, or the backtester results.
